title: The Locked Room
author: Chris Schneider
description:
'The Locked Room'

This is a simple riddle adventure. You only need to accomplish three tasks to escape and win the game.

You will be awarded points for each completed task and some sub-task. To win the game you must complete the below tasks and your score needs to be 100.

1> You must figure out how to eat
2> You must figure out how to drink
3> You must figure out how to escape
